name: Fogging (AFOG)

lead: In looksmaxxing vocabulary, fogging is when a woman outshines a man, who is then said to be fogged. AFOG is the related label for the woman doing it, formed in the same style as AMOG.

The term is used to talk about relative looks in a group, which is why it appears in discussions of why appearance improvement matters. It is purely a community concept and no studies have examined it.

paras: It is not something people do; it is a way of describing group dynamics, for example when a very attractive woman in a friend group draws more attention than her peers.
There are no physical risks. Some threads that use the term discuss it in connection with distress, which is a sensitive area in these communities.

angle.text: The term gives users a name for when a more attractive person overshadows others. Community members use such examples as motivation to improve their own appearance.

lead: Fogging is looksmaxxing slang for a woman outshining a man, with the man described as fogged. AFOG is the term for the woman who does so. The vocabulary parallels the better-known term AMOG and belongs to the community's way of describing relative attractiveness in a group.

On looksmax.org the word appears in thread titles such as one describing a hot blonde who keeps fogging her friends, which shows it is used for women who attract more attention than those around them [1]. Community members treat these social comparisons as motivation to improve their own looks. No research uses the term.

paras: The term appears in forum threads about women overshadowing peers, with titles referencing a woman fogging her friends [1].
